A text said my account code is 482913 and I should reply if I didn't ask for it.

I didn't reply. But a few minutes later a woman called from a number on my screen and said she's from my bank. She wants me to read back the code I just got. I'm still on the phone with her.

Please stop talking to her now.
1. Never give your verification code to someone else.
2. Hang up.
3. Block their number.
4. Use a number you trust, like the one on your statement or in your app.
5. Never use the number the caller gave you; it'll take you to the scammer.
6. Then report them to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.
